how: Captured native hook stdin as a non-root user in an isolated k3s Linux arm64 sandbox (Asia/Singapore). Used the Core kick prompt, run_command including a nonzero exit, and /compact in print mode. For the 401 capture, used a dummy key against a loopback HTTP fixture returning 401 UNAUTHENTICATED. Retained payload fields as emitted.

files.session-start-kick.json: SessionStart from the same literal kick prompt used by Core.
files.pre-invocation-later.json: Second invocation following a tool result.
files.stop-idle.json: Normal fully idle Stop after the kick.
files.stop-auth-error.json: Native Stop after the isolated loopback endpoint returned HTTP 401 UNAUTHENTICATED.
files.post-tool-use.json: Native PostToolUse for run_command with an empty error field.
files.post-tool-use-nonzero-exit.json: Matching native PostToolUse after the fixture command exited 7. The native error field is empty.
